current.text: Milwaukee got him from Miami in the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade. He is a lock to start, in a projected opening lineup of Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Kuzma and Turner.
He is on a 33 million USD expiring contract.

Experts call him the best player on the Bucks and their top offensive option. He should lead the team in scoring and take on part of the creation role. Moving to Milwaukee does not change his value much.

He could be traded. Experts expect him to stay at least until the trade deadline, when he could be moved because Burries is the long-term shooting guard. The roster needs trades to consolidate, and Herro does not fit well on it.

The Bucks have a crowded guard group, and the rotation under new coach Taylor Jenkins is very unclear. One expert says guard depth and a growing focus on young players may keep his minutes below 34 to 35. Another notes he will not play point guard.
At 35 minutes per game he would be a top 35 player.
Injuries limited him to 33 games last season, which raises durability concerns.

Experts disagree on his price. Most call a draft spot in rounds 6 to 7 (around picks 58 to 70) fair or strong, and one says he seems locked into that range. One 2026-10-09 note lists him among players to avoid and says ESPN points rank 56 may be his best case.

The Bucks are expected to be bad, at about 33 wins. They do not own their draft pick, so they have no reason to tank. Still, the focus on young players is expected to grow during the season, which would cut veteran minutes.

durable.text: He is an elite free throw shooter and a decent passer.
He has a long injury history that could come back.
His category value comes from FT%, threes and points. Steals, blocks and turnovers are below the pool, but none of them is a real weakness.

note: Both sites rank him 65th, and he cost 14 USD in our auction last season. Yahoo values him at 16 USD and ESPN at 7 USD, so a bid around 10 to 15 USD fits the round 6 to 7 range most experts accept. He helps in FT%, threes and points with no weak category, so he fits any build.
